explanation.whatDescription: A conjunction happens when two celestial bodies appear very close to each other in the sky, as seen from Earth — they aren't actually close in space, it's just an apparent alignment.

params.separation: The angular distance between the two objects at the moment of closest approach.
params.position: Azimuth / altitude: the direction to look at during the conjunction.
params.time: The precise time of closest approach.
